title: Trailblazer’s Nook

body: This stunning brand new Papago van was crafted with precision and care, tailored specifically to meet the needs of a discerning customer who values both luxury and adventure.

Powered by a 300W solar system and a 400Ah Lithium Iron Battery, this van was designed to thrive off-grid. The 3000W pure sine wave inverter/charger and 50Amp DC to DC/solar charger combo ensured that the customer would have reliable power for all their devices, whether exploring remote trails or staying connected at a campsite.

The interior was meticulously planned to offer comfort and convenience on the road. The kitchen, featuring an Acacia butcher block countertop, a portable induction cooktop, and a 3 cubic foot Isotherm refrigerator/freezer, provided the perfect setup for preparing meals on the go. The indoor wet-bath, with its cassette-style toilet and hot water shower, brought the comforts of home to every corner of their journey.

Climate control was a top priority, with a Nomadic X2 12v AC unit and an Espar diesel-powered cabin heater, ensuring comfort in any weather. The van's insulation, crafted from premium Havelock wool, and the Maxxair Deluxe ceiling vent fan with remote added to the overall comfort, making the interior a cozy retreat no matter the conditions outside.

Aesthetically, the van was a true reflection of the customer’s taste, with painted shiplap siding, a stained wood ceiling, and vinyl wood-style flooring creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. The thoughtful storage solutions, including overhead cabinets, under-counter compartments, and a floor-to-ceiling closet with an adjustable shelf and mirror, provided ample space for all their belongings, ensuring everything had its place.
